mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (id, session_id, role, content, tokens, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, model, provider, finish_reason, latency_ms, usage_source, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{sessionId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{tokens}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{model}, #{provider}, #{finishReason}, #{latencyMs}, #{usageSource}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, role, content, tokens, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, model, provider, finish_reason, latency_ms, usage_source, created_at FROM message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, CASE role WHEN 'user' THEN 0 WHEN 'assistant' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC
